workload: One warm-cache Reader.read of MovieLens-1M ratings.dat (1000209 UIR rows, separator '::').
notes: Reader.read builds the result with a Python strip/split/float comprehension. A bytes split of the same cached file returns identical tuples and is about 200ms faster than this 577ms call, so a local parser change can save more than 10ms per call. noise_pct is (max-min)/median*100 over 5 runs (575.750..589.366). Overlap: the only open upstream PR is #741 (next_item_evaluation.py). PRs merged since 2026-10-13 (#728-#740) do not touch reader.py. author:dexhunter on preferredAI/cornac is only #731 and #741. No open issue says Reader is being refactored, deprecated, or moved.

workload: One ranking_eval of MostPop with Recall@10 on a seed-42 80/20 MovieLens-1M RatioSplit (rating threshold 1.0).
notes: Each test user copies a CSR row and allocates full-catalog positive/negative masks before a cheap MostPop rank. Keeping those masks and reading CSR indptr/indices directly matched every per-user Recall score and cut the same call from about 821ms to about 442ms. noise_pct is (max-min)/median*100 over 5 runs (844.776..888.444). Overlap: this is not next_item_evaluation.ranking_eval (#731 merged, #741 open) and not recommender.rank (touched by #728 and #737). base_method.py has no commit since 2023. No open issue marks it refactor/deprecated/moved.

workload: AUC.compute for every MovieLens-1M test user on MostPop scores, with candidates built the same way as ranking_eval (seed-42 80/20 split, rating threshold 1.0).
notes: AUC.compute tiles every positive score against every negative score via np.repeat and np.tile. Tracemalloc peak for that loop is 12671649 bytes (identical across 5 runs). A sort plus searchsorted counts the same strict-greater pairs, including ties as non-wins, and removes well over 1MiB of that temporary. Overlap: ranking.py is not in open PRs or PRs merged since 2026-10-13. dexhunter #731 and #741 do not touch it. Open issue #530 asks to improve ranking metrics but does not say AUC is being refactored, deprecated, or moved, and there is no PR.

workload: One L2 row-normalize (copy=True) of the dense MovieLens-1M user-item rating matrix, 6040 users by 3706 items.
notes: The dense l2 path copies the matrix and then allocates a full X**2 temporary, so one call peaks at 358202959 traced bytes (identical across 5 runs). The matrix itself is 179042560 bytes; row-chunked squaring matches NumPy's axis=1 sum of squares bit-for-bit on a 6040x3706 float64 matrix and drops about 179MB of peak while returning the same normalized rows. Overlap: common.py is not in open PRs or PRs merged since 2026-10-13. No open issue says normalize is being refactored, deprecated, or moved.
